71550456-530c-56b4-9f71-d384445089f6: Creative expression is a way to integrate phenomenon and visions experienced in altered states of consciousness, whether they be meditative or entheogenic in nature. From the very first forms of mark-making to the caves of Lascaux to the works of Pablo Amaringo and Alex Grey, humanity has sought to understand our internal landscapes through visual expression. Alligator Lizards in the Air: Healing and Integration through Creative Expression, is a once a month chance to bring these experiences to life through two dimensional mark making. Art mediums from paint to colored pencils, crayons to markers, will be available for everyone to use along with paper and canvas. Krisztina Lazar will be your visionary guide in creativity and will help you realize your experience before your eyes. No art background needed for this class. All you need is an open mind and a willingness to explore. No one turned away for lack of funds. If this applies to you, please email hello@berkeleyalembic.org at least 48 hours before the event start. Krisztina Lazar is a visionary artist primarily working in oil paint, watercolor and drawing. She is a Mische Technique lineage holder, a mixture of oil and egg tempera painting invented during the Dutch Renaissance and revolutionized by modern master, Ernst Fuchs. This technique creates an opalescent under painting that the colors are then glazed over, rendering each painting out of light rather than shadow, bringing the images to life with fractal clarity. Utilizing this transformative style that she learned from visionary pioneer, Brigid Marlin, her current body of work explores painting a hybrid of Mische and Alla Prima to render hyperealistic sacred art. With these two techniques combined, Krisztina creates images of Pop Shamanism, portals and visions that speak to today’s cultural climate of the occult, magic, fantasy, psychedelics, meditation, pop, nostalgia, and the environment movement. Originally from Cleveland, OH, she completed her BFA at Carnegie Mellon University in 2004 and her MFA graduate degree in 2011 at the San Francisco Art Institute New Genres department. Her paintings have been exhibited in group and solo shows throughout the United States and Europe, most notably at the H.R. Geiger museum in Gruyere, Switzerland. She teaches her unique styles of painting to many students in group and private settings. Her work has been featured in multiple articles, galleries and book publications. She currently lives and works in Northern California.
e4216f42-88ec-5ae5-9fe1-424f177fbace: 5Rhythms® dance is a profound medicine, offering a dynamic movement map into the vast, unexplored wilderness between our head and feet. Each rhythm - Flowing, Staccato, Chaos, Lyrical, and Stillness, is a gateway, a wisdom teacher guiding us toward greater presence, healing, and transformation. This event occurs every two weeks at the Alembic. In a Sweat Your Prayers®, we support your individual practice with the rhythms and your movement journey by dancing wave after wave with light guidance. People often leave feeling cleansed, grounded, more alive, and more connected to themselves and their deeper knowing. 5Rhythms® is for every body. Many have discovered that not having prior dance training is actually liberating! Bring your body temple and a willingness to be surprised by what's waiting to move in and through you. The dance will end around 12:15pm, followed by a closing circle until around 12:30-ish. We encourage spacious arrivals and unhurried departures. So plan your time generously: a little time to land, a little time to linger, and a little less rushing back into the busy world. This dance can be your mini-retreat for the week! Teacher Bio: Qibei is a 5Rhythms® teacher, mindfulness teacher, holistic healer, and Associate Marriage and Family Therapist, though no title could fully capture the many worlds she moves between. Her work bridges the clinical and the mystical, the tender and the fierce, the grounded intelligence of the body and the mystery of Spirit moving through human life. For over 20 years, alongside 5Rhythms®, her path has been richly shaped by Continuum Movement, Open Floor, somatic contemplative practice, and relational communication. Over time, these disciplines began weaving together into the way she listens, guides, and teaches. For Qibei, dance is medicine, prayer, and creative laboratory, a place where we can move beyond numbness, habitual defenses, and rigid identities we’ve learned to carry, and reconnect with our raw aliveness and deeper knowing. She believes embodied presence is what brings depth, vitality, connection, and magic into our lives. In her movement spaces, Qibei creates a trauma-sensitive and inclusive field for all bodies, inviting authentic expression and the dynamic interplay between body, heart, psyche, and spirit. Her music and facilitation are often described as exquisite, nourishing, and deeply transporting, guiding movers into inner landscapes they didn’t know they could reach. Qibei also facilitates women's circle and retreats. Learn more about her work at www.Qibei.be.
